messages:
ashley.cse: Quick one — Opal Health returned our vendor security form with two asks: they want EU-only data residency called out, and a short list of subcontractors we use. They also flagged this as a renewal blocker if we can't confirm. cc @devon.sec :thinking:

devon.sec: Can you paste the exact question text or attach the form link? EU-only can be tricky depending on whether they're on Hosted or Dedicated.

ashley.cse: Pasted below (their wording): \u201cPlease confirm all processing locations and list any subprocessors. Our renewal will hinge on EU residency guarantees.\u201d Link: https://opalhealth.questionnaire/resp-123

sam.platform: If they're on Dedicated we can scope an EU-only deployment + routing. Hosted: we only have region preference but cannot guarantee full EU-only unless the customer is on a Private/Dedicated plan.

mike.eng: For subprocessors we typically provide this list: `S3 (aws-eu-west-1), Redis (managed-eu), Logstash (ops partner), Monitoring (datadog-eu)` — we can generate the vendor contact list. Also note that our KMS is customer-key for Dedicated/Private, hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS.

devon.sec: Agreed. For SOC2 evidence: attach our latest SOC2 report + data flow diagram and a brief statement re: subprocessors and contracts. Redlines: we dont accept blanket EU-only guarantees for hosted customers. Suggest wording: 
```
We can commit to storing and processing data in EU regions for Dedicated or Private deployments. For Hosted deployments we will process in EU regions where available but cannot provide absolute exclusivity unless on a Dedicated/Private plan. Our subprocessors are contractually bound to Redwoods data protection terms and EU data transfer safeguards where applicable.
```

ashley.cse: Nice, thanks. Is there a canonical subprocessors file I can attach? Also they asked for a high-level org chart showing who has access to production.

ops-bot: Docs: https://redwood.docs/internal/subprocessors.csv, SOC2: https://redwood.docs/internal/soc2-redwood-2025.pdf, Data flow diag: https://redwood.docs/internal/dataflow-opal.png :white_check_mark:

mike.eng: Use `subprocessors.csv` and redact non-essential contact details. For org chart, attach `access-matrix-production.pdf` (ops team keeps the latest). I can DM the redacted copy.

devon.sec: Also flag to legal if they request contract amendments. This is a small T&Cs ask that could become a contractual exception. @ashley.cse please escalate to AE if they call it a renewal blocker.

ashley.cse: Will do. Next steps for me: send a response with SOC2 + subprocessors + our suggested wording, note the deployment caveat, and request any specific subprocessors theyre concerned about. If they push for EU-only on Hosted, escalate to AE/legal. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam.platform: If we think this will convert to Dedicated, /cc @mike.eng for onboarding ETA so we can scope timeline for them.

ashley.cse: Good call. I'll flag as potential renewal risk and start the enablement thread.

mike.eng: If they want Dedicated onboarding estimate: ~4 weeks minimal (provisioning, KMS handoff, data migration plan).

ashley.cse: Perfect, saving that. Closing the loop here, will post updates in the customer record and send the draft reply shortly.
